title: Sequential Fair Allocation and Routing in Nonprofit Operations
summary: We study a dynamic fair sequential allocation problem in which a central planner distributes a divisible resource across multiple locations under demand uncertainty. Motivated by applications such as humanitarian relief and food distribution, we incorporate routing decisions into the planner's problem and jointly optimize allocation and visitation order under two max-min fairness objectives, ex-post and forward.
